a.lede: Google is turning Gemini into an AI agent that can plan, execute tasks, and work across business apps and systems. The agent can delegate work to subagents, use multiple AI models, and even gets its own workplace identity, complete with an email address.
a.title: Google brings agentic AI to Gemini, starting with businesses

b.lede: The Chocolate Factory proposes a single universal agent for work
b.title: There can be only one: Google Cloud casts Gemini as your enterprise AI hero
